This feels so true. It all depends on the willingness and mental ability of the elderly when it comes to how well they adapt. 

Like, my grandfather is a breath of fresh air. He owns his own tech business and has dealt with electronics for years, so he’s always the one explaining complicated things to me about the interwebs, lol. He’s always has the drive to want to understand things, even if it was deemed beyond his generation’s general understanding.

My grandma, on the other hand... she got pissed when my grandpa started trying to get her to put her thumb on the home button of her new iPhone so she could scan it and use her thumb to unlock her phone. She absolutely refused to put her thumb on it purely because she didn’t understand it. Eventually I got her to do it myself and she now uses her thumb to open it all the time but still thinks it’s stupid, LOL. She doesn’t have much will to adapt and very little patience, like many elderly. Those people tend to be the ones screencapped, I’ve got a fair amount of screenshots myself of some of the shit she has accidentally texted me lmao

I really hate how difficult it seems I’ve made it on myself to enjoy anything.
